description: National Physical Planning Department - Declare that the Area Gonnawa Sri Vishnu Devalaya as an Urban development Area. Declare that the Area Tangalle Henakaduwa Historic Raja Maha Viharaya as an Urban development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically declaring two areas ("Gonnawa Sri Vishnu Devalaya" and "Tangalle Henakaduwa Historic Raja Maha Viharaya") as urban development areas under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. The content includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, survey plans, and extent measurements, which are characteristic of land-related gazette notifications. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the land declaration process rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
